attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as router between two VLANs: eth1 (192.168.10.1/24) toward node2, eth2 (192.168.20.1/24) toward node3, with IPv4 forwarding enabled globally and per-interface. node2 (192.168.10.2/24 on enp8s0) and node3 (192.168.20.2/24 on enp8s0) each got a static route to the other's subnet via node1. Verified full bidirectional ping between node2 and node3 across the VLAN boundary (ttl=63 confirming one hop). Config was persisted (SONiC via /etc/network/interfaces.d + sysctl.d; RHEL9 via nmcli connection profiles) and all three nodes were sequentially restarted (one at a time) using native reboot, each showing a changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id and full recovery of interfaces, forwarding sysctls, static routes, and end-to-end cross-VLAN connectivity afterward.
